name: audit-forwarded-exports
goal: Audit explicit named runtime forwarding exports without admitting type-only, wildcard or misleading exports

evidence: Owner-local implementations retain explicit named forwarding exports for compatibility, but hasNamedValueExport only recognizes declaration forms. Audit falsely rejects these public names. Type-only or wildcard exports must still not satisfy a required runtime export.

Standard adapter and generated-project naming tests exercised declarations, but not runtime export lists. Extend their existing matrices with direct, alias, multiline and local export lists plus type-only, wildcard, comment and string negative cases.
